statements.statement_text: PCP-003 defines the Stage 1 characterization of the A-Mab production bioreactor (Step 3).
Nine process parameters are characterized against the bioreactor-set CQAs.
The study uses a screening fractional-factorial design followed by a response-surface design on a 2 L scale-down model.
Models are acceptable when there is no significant lack of fit against the center-point pure error.
The study must establish a design space over which every in-scope CQA is satisfied simultaneously.

source_references.quote: a design space exists over which every in-scope CQA is satisfied simultaneously

assertions.assertion_text: Afucosylation is measured by AMV-3010.
Galactosylation (total %Gal) is measured by AMV-3010.
High Mannose is measured by AMV-3010.
Aggregates (HMW) is measured by AMV-3011.
Acidic charge variants (deamidation) is measured by AMV-3013.
Host Cell Protein (HCP) is measured by AMV-3012.
Residual DNA is measured by AMV-3014.
Afucosylation acceptance: 2–13 % of glycans.
Galactosylation (total %Gal) acceptance: 10–40 % (G1+G2 equiv.).
High Mannose acceptance: 3–10 % of glycans.
Aggregates (HMW) acceptance: 0–5 % HMW (SEC).
Acidic charge variants (deamidation) acceptance: 18–40 % (CEX/icIEF).
Host Cell Protein (HCP) acceptance: 0–100 ng/mg.
Residual DNA acceptance: 0–0.001 ng/dose.
